verdict.rationale: Each skill ships its own SKILL.md describing what it does (review, qa, ship, office-hours, autoplan, cso, upgrade, learn, skillify), and docs/skills.md catalogs the skills with role descriptions. Activation behavior is documented in places: qa voice-trigger aliases, the root router skill dispatching requests, auto-upgrade gating, per-host domain-skill injection, and end-of-session learning logs. missing for 10: explicit activation/trigger conditions shown for every skill (only qa's triggers are evidenced), independent or hands-on corroboration that the docs predict agent behavior.
